audit.whatIsWrong: The entire chart was inverted. Six of seven rows gave Irelia the level at 2/10 while every one of whys[0] through whys[5] reads 'Illaoi-favoured', and Illaoi wins 54.12% over 935 games. The page also read 8.5/10 difficulty, red tone and 'Hard matchup' on a lane she wins.
audit.why: The rendered chart contradicted the sentence printed directly under each row and the win rate above it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Illaoi with ratings to match, 2+ items left with Irelia at 3/10, as one atomic group across both layers; diffRating, tone, the difficulty line, the rating line and the chart blurb brought into agreement.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a cooldown, and the level-6 window gave no reason beyond 'a full tentacle ring'.
audit.why: Bladesurge is 10s at rank 1 and refreshes only on a Marked target or a kill; Flawless Duet is 16s; Vanguard's Edge is 125s. Those numbers are what make 'deny her resets' actionable.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the cooldown block and the do's rather than padded into the spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent everywhere. Flawless Duet GROUNDS as well as stuns, so it shuts off Harsh Lesson — the page only called it 'her engage CC'. And Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage while charging, which is exactly what tentacles and slams deal.
audit.why: Illaoi's whole damage profile is physical, so trading into a charging W is the single worst thing she can do in this matchup, and it was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[1].t, report[5].t and the TL;DR. report[5] also states the counter — Leap of Faith grounds Bladesurge back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia is called 'he'/'his' in ten fields.
audit.why: Reads as a template that was never proofread.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the trade lines, wave lines, feeding lines, late line and matching report entries.

audit.why: Bladesurge heals her, and the missing-interactions file calls for Grievous Wounds; report[8] already prescribes Executioner's Calling early.
audit.corrected: Only the pronoun in that line changed.

notes: This page rendered a lost lane over prose describing a won one: six chart rows gave Irelia the level at 2/10 while every why under them said 'Illaoi-favoured', against a 54.12% win rate. Two mechanics were missing entirely. Flawless Duet GROUNDS as well as stuns, so it shuts off Harsh Lesson — that is why baiting it matters. And Defiant Dance reduces physical damage while charging, which is precisely what tentacles and slams deal, making 'slam her whenever' actively wrong. Ten 'he/his' references to Irelia fixed.
